label_policy.exact_controls: Benchmark labels contain broad strategy families only; exact hubs, windows, capacity, and controls require a content-pinned published overlay.
label_policy.leakage_control: The classifier must produce its prediction without reading the benchmark label.
label_policy.status: Analyst-coded from reviewed official public sources; source pages are linked but raw responses are not republished in this artifact.
